115994136.title: File:St. Anthony Hall Tau (M.I.T.) Chapter House and St. Anthony Club of Boston, 1906.jpg

ObjectName.value: St. Anthony Hall Tau (M.I.T.) Chapter House and St. Anthony Club of Boston, 1906

ImageDescription.value: This image is from "Catalog of the members of the fraternity of Delta Psi,"1906. The first Fraternity of Delta Psi (St Anthony Hall) Tau chapter house was designed by J.P. Fuller and built circa 1834–37 in the Greek Revival style. The Tau Chapter is at M.I.T. The chapter house  was located within at 6 Louisburg Square in Boston's Beacon Hill neighborhood. The building was also home to the St. Anthony Club of Boston. This address also the origin of the nickname for the Tau chapter—the Number Six Club

Artist.value: Fraternity of Delta Psi (St. Anthony Hall)

34175192.title: File:Using Open Data and Stories to Broaden Crowd Content.pdf

ObjectName.value: Using Open Data and Stories to Broaden Crowd Content

ImageDescription.value: Slides from a talk by J. Nathan Matias to the Wikimedia Analytics / Research Data / Showcase on July 16, 2014. These slides show an overview of the work of the Center for Civic Media, describe two projects in crowdsourced content creation (NewsPad and Eventful), and then describe a series of projects that use data to provide transparency on gender disparities in content and support broader diversity in crowd-created resources like Wikipedia.
Visualizing Cultures
Vortrag von Max Tegmark, Massachusetts Institute of Technology im April 2014
